definition: A type of hearing loss (represented in the Human Phenotype Ontology by HP:0000407, sensorineural hearing impairment) that arises from pathology affecting the sensory receptor cells of the cochlea, the auditory nerve, or central auditory processing pathways, frequently presenting as a key neurological and genetic manifestation in inherited neurometabolic disorders.
